description: Land Title Settlement Department - Palapotha East, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830119 (23/0945)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (No. 2:145, 2:146 and 2:147) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
